# olivares_model_group (Resource)

A model group in the Olivares AI control plane (models module): a named set of model IDs that policies and budgets can reference as a single unit. Authoring requires models:model-group:write.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A named set of models that policies and budgets can refer to by group instead of
# repeating every model id at each call site.
resource "olivares_model_group" "production" {
  name        = "production-models"
  description = "Models approved for production use"
  models      = ["gpt-4o", "claude-sonnet-4-5", "claude-haiku-3-5"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable model group name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of the model group's purpose.
- `models` (List of String) List of model identifiers that belong to this group. Omit for an empty group.
- `tenant` (String) Tenant UUID for this resource, overriding the provider-level tenant. Sent as X-Olivares-Tenant.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Server-assigned creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Server-assigned model group ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Server-assigned last-update timestamp (RFC 3339).
